In ambiguous pronoun resolution tasks, I should not rely solely on grammatical proximity or narrative logic; instead, I must explicitly evaluate if the sentence structure allows for multiple valid antecedents. Next time, I will analyze whether the verb phrase "had a rare skin condition" logically applies to both potential referents (the patient and the specialist). If both are plausible, I will select option (C) Ambiguous rather than forcing a single interpretation based on assumption.
